summary: The agent constructs a reasonable pipeline with automated handling of categoricals and missing values, utilizing inverse-RMSE weighted ensembling of tree-based regressors. However, it exhibits critical flaws including dropping the explicit test IDs in favor of a generated sequence, leaking validation data statistics by applying frequency encoding prior to the train/validation split, and poorly handling ensemble weights if a model fails during inference.
